request: A mega audit of the user's onboard video against the drawn kart hall, to make it close to the real place.

reference.what: The user's own onboard video of a lap of Gokartcentralen Goteborg, 40.6 s, a 30.101 s lap
reference.kept: outside the repository, as a private reference; no frame of it is committed
reference.read: two frames a second, laid against the traced 400 m track by its ten turns

comparison.method: fd_desktop --kart --camera 2 --at-station S --capture-scene FILE at 24 stations, each beside the video's frame at the matching time
corrected_after_first_pass: floor too blue and too even: made neutral, darker underfoot, with stronger lamp streaks
fence ran 25 m up the approach to the ninth corner: now from where the bend tightens, a plain banner for 18 m after it
footbridge 10 m too early: moved to 378 m
gallery wall ended at 10 m: now runs to 18 m, its door near its end
east wall a bare red plane: darker, with a balcony's deck edge, posts and rail
round red deck over the ninth corner's island missing: added
yellow wedge too large and too near the first corner: smaller, further along the west wall
cockpit floor tray lit grey: matt black

not_done: driving the hall with a controller
a frame-rate measurement after the second pass
any measurement of the real hall: wall positions, heights, lamp counts and the bank's 6 degrees are chosen
people, other karts, lettering, the red stair tower, reflections of the walls in the floor
